scope: New adjustable component kit responding to documented D09 salon arrival, quiet edge and planted court. Historical host geometry remains unavailable.

frames.source: metres; Blender +Z up, +X across component, -Y guest/use front
frames.placement: Each actual native node hierarchy is authoritative; source pivots must be stated per component

proposed_compatible_profile.note: Editable initial profile values for the new kit, not dimensions read from the lost host. Use substantial joined profiles; avoid luminous outlines and unsupported thin trim.

later_documented_component_maxima.note: Authoring maxima in the later historical contract, not measured built envelopes or door datums

proposed_qa_arrangement.status: Proposed adjustable inspection coordinates only. No moving leaves. Exact host polygon, door mechanism and real actor/cart routes must be reconciled before adoption.

orientation_contract.inspection_source_scene: Ship(x,y,z)=(BlenderX,BlenderZ,-BlenderY), with ship y measured above the D09 floor in this inspection scene. Thus Blender X=ship x, Blender Y=-ship z, Blender Z=height above deck.
orientation_contract.quiet_local_to_inspection_source: Local component front -Y faces +shipZ; no source-Z rotation, front datum at inspection source Y=+2
orientation_contract.portal_local_to_inspection_source: Rotate local source about +Z by -90deg so front -Y faces -shipX and depth +Y enters along +shipX
orientation_contract.planted_local_to_inspection_source: Rotate local source about +Z by180deg so front -Y faces -shipZ; front datum at inspection source Y=-2
orientation_contract.limit: Exact component origins and total rotated bounds remain to be checked after authored sources exist

requirements: Keep historical door positions, transverse arrival/service connection along ship X at Z0, tram reserve and terrace connection explicit

Collision proposals retain actual useful voids; unknown door sweep envelopes cannot be silently filled or credited as passing
No early 7.4m court scheme is revived as final; use later nested-bay guidance and purpose-built transitions
Sources are new authored catalogue work, not recovered lost assets
Keep rising cove, all trim and fixture geometry within quiet-edge maximum; no cove spanning the proposed through strip
